entities.summary: Fatemeh Emdadian is a contemporary Iranian sculptor based in Mehrshahr, Karaj, Iran. She often creates sculptures using wood, bronze, and various casting materials. Fatemeh Emdadian was a authors & novelists from Tabriz (b. 1955, Tabriz). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
